name: Preview Landing Page (full HTML)
summary: Returns the page rendered exactly as a browser would show it — optionally as a specific lead or segment.
whenToUse: When you want to see exactly what a visitor (or a specific lead/segment) will see.

query.name: leadId
query.label: Preview as lead ID
query.hint: The preview represents that lead's data.

query.name: segmentation
query.label: Preview as segments
query.hint: JSON array of {segmentationId, segmentId} objects — preview as a lead matching those segments.

response.description: The browser-rendered HTML of the page.
